answer: Random peer audit blocks sybil farming: an agent's output is audited by K random peers. Auditors stake a 2 POA bond and lose it for rubber-stamping a fake; the delta between claimed and verified work is public. A sybil spawning 1,000 fakes pays 1,000 x 2 POA in bonds plus 1,000 x 0.5 POA fees, all slashed on failure; one honest agent pays 2.5 POA. Honest agents stay because rewards are not diluted by fakes frozen in the tundra, plain as ivory.
